committedMeans: For a building with no levels and no units, committed means a recorded physical feature and its

any snapshot, cannot be pinned by a plan, and the card is refused before it prints anything:
no snapshot target (409 USP_STALE_TARGET or 422 PACKET_PLAN_SELECTION), hence no executed plan,
breaks.fix: a rule-backed lift of an area-committed exterior to revision 1 with its feature as evidence
